# lineage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:qualityDimensionLineage`](gmeow-qualityDimensionLineage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/qualityDimensionLineage>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/quality`](../../slices/quality.md)

The history, source, and process steps that produced a dataset or entity — the provenance of the data viewed through a quality lens. In GMEOW the structural lineage is recorded by [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md), [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md), and [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ImportActivity.md) (provenance module); this dimension value marks a quality assessment that evaluates lineage completeness or correctness.
